correctness.rationale: Polar vertices correspond exactly to centered integral graph-Lipschitz potentials with connected graph of tight edges, a full-rank criterion. Anchoring hubs yields d=0 with all leaves ±1 (type A) or d=±1 with leaves 0 or d (type B), complete 3*2^q classification. Squared polar norms are q-(2t-q)^2/(q+2) or k(q+2-k)/(q+2), with 2q or q+1 facet vertices respectively. Antipodal facet inequalities bound global inball radius by inverse maximal norm, attained at origin; rank of balanced leaf-sign tangent normals gives affine dimension 2 for even q, 1 for odd. Comparing second type-A shell with maximal B shell yields exact q=2,3 tie, stabilization and O(q^-5/2) shell clearance. Independent 2<=q<=10 exact shell identities and proof of nonnegative norm gap; source code independently enumerates potentials q1..10.
